recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed in core unless the work group later asks for broader Procedure-specific explanatory text beyond the approved Device Boundary/Scope subsection.
issue_request: FHIR-38674 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request asking FHIR-core Device/Procedure guidance to clarify that a specific device instance should be represented with Device rather than DeviceDefinition even when details such as lot or serial number are not known, with examples for a pump used in a Procedure and replacement of one device by another of the same type.
initial_application: Jira records application in commit 9197480014a08d8494b2f2aec7c30b2705fc7e62. Git history confirms that commit added the Device and DeviceDefinition subsection and requested examples to source/device/device-introduction.xml; 7ae447a3bdd9ff0d1112282e32b597cd39c992a6 later fixed malformed HTML and refined the replacement-device sentence, and d8299e2070537663edb7fdfac87d3b706b38a96c adjusted only the heading level.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Device and Procedure as active resources. Current Device source contains the approved subsection under Scope and Usage. DeviceDefinition source describes DeviceDefinition as a type/kind and Device as an actual instance, and Procedure source has no conflicting DeviceDefinition guidance. OO minutes from 2022 record the original example request, while 2024 OO minutes say FHIR-38674 had been voted but not yet applied. Related Jira FHIR-33326 is a Resolved - No Change Procedure.used request that cites FHIR-38674 as the reason Device, not DeviceDefinition, is appropriate for a specific device used in a Procedure; other nearby keys concern separate device-settings or nutrition questions.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current active Device page already implements the final Jira decision and no additional Procedure or DeviceDefinition source edit is necessary for implementer understanding.
